FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Office Essentials Co., we specialize in providing a comprehensive range of standard office supplies, including paper products, writing instruments, folders, and stationery essentials. Our retail storefront and online platform are designed to cater to both individual consumers and businesses, ensuring convenient access to quality products. We prioritize a safe shopping environment and maintain compliance with all relevant local and federal regulations to minimize risks associated with operations. Our dedicated team conducts regular inventory management and loss prevention audits to keep our supplies readily available while safeguarding against theft and operational disruptions. Our focus on delivering high-quality, essential office supplies positions us as a reliable partner for our customers' office needs.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss occurred on 04/15/2023 due to a water leak from an overhead pipe, leading to the damage of inventory including paper supplies and writing instruments. The estimated loss amount is $1,500.00. Status: Claim settled and amount recovered.

FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sundays
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Burglar-resistant safe, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and monitored surveillance system.
